description: Baseline Capability Ledger - permanent, low-risk capabilities that ship with Foreman. Identical in every consumer repository. Higher-risk capabilities live in .harness/knowledge/capabilities.json (standing, per-repo) or .harness/run/capabilities.json (goal-scoped). One entry reaches the network by the human's decision: the Context7 documentation lookup (ADR-032), which a repository can switch off with a 'deny' rule in its own ledger. Note: git push is NOT here - it is network access, a High-risk class under POLICIES.md, granted per repository and scoped to the Loop Branch (ADR-011). Worker subagents are restricted further still, by the tools array in .harness/loop/agents.json.

entries.intent: Read repository files and search the codebase
Create and edit files inside the repository (protected paths are covered by deny rules)
Inspect and locally persist git state (checkpoints on the Loop Branch); no push, no merge, no history rewriting

Look up a third-party library's current documentation through Context7 when a build, test, lint or review failure names that library's API, so a retry is based on new information (ADR-032). The one baseline entry that reaches the network: a query carries only a library's public name and a concept, never repository code. A repository opts out with a matching 'deny' rule in its own ledger.
entries.command: npx -y ctx7 library <name> <concept> --json / npx -y ctx7 docs <library-id> <concept> --json (telemetry off)
entries.scope: read-only queries to Context7's public index; setup, login and remove are not granted

entries.intent: Drive the app this repository is building on an attached device or emulator - install it, clear its data, grant or revoke its permissions, start it, read its screen, tap its controls, read its own notifications and logs - so criteria that need a running app are driven before a person looks (ADR-030, ADR-033). adb itself is denied in both Run Modes; this wrapper is the only route, and it refuses any other package and has no operation that changes a device setting.
entries.scope: the debug build of this repository, identified by the build's own output metadata and confirmed DEBUGGABLE on the device; never another app, the device's settings, its clock or its notification shade

autonomous.description: Autonomous mode only (ADR-027, ENGINE.md 14.3). Replaces every ledger's allow rules with 'every tool', and denies the list below on top of run.ps1's immutable deny rules. Two kinds of entry: raw forms of actions that are allowed only through a Recovery Wrapper in .harness/loop/bin/ (push, rm outside the repo), and actions no wrapper can make undoable (publishing, deploying, merging, messaging). Add repository-specific denials as 'deny' arrays in .harness/knowledge/capabilities.json entries. This list is prefix matching over command strings - it stops an engine that slips, not one that routes around it.
